basics.name: Mallikarjuna Tupakula
basics.label: ML Researcher | AI Safety & Science
basics.summary: Independent student researcher pursuing MS in Computer Science at Rochester Institute of Technology with full graduate scholarship. Focused on AI Safety, AI for Science, Multimodal Learning, and NeuroAI. Published sole-author work at NeurIPS'25 FM4LS workshop.

work.name: Rochester Institute of Technology
work.summary: Independent student researcher working on AI Safety, AI for Science, Multimodal Learning, and NeuroAI. Advisor: Prof. Ashique KhudaBukhsh
highlights: Sole-authored publication at NeurIPS 2025 (FM4LS) on 'Thin Bridges for Drug Text Alignment: Lightweight Contrastive Learning for Target Specific Drug Retrieval' - achieving Recall@1 = 0.762 on ChEMBL and 3× scaffold-split gain over baselines

Co-authored publication in INFORMS Journal on Computing: developed multimodal machine-comprehension framework evaluating 48,956 YouTube Kids videos; achieved 77.5% accuracy on ScienceQA and F1 = 0.82 on CVQA dataset
Developing diffusion-based brain decoding pipelines using fMRI data and image reconstruction for multimodal perception tasks with Stable Diffusion and CLIP embeddings

Developing large-scale empathetic dialogue systems using CANDOR dataset (1 TB video/audio/text) and studying LLM neuron interpretability to align multimodal agents with human values for safer reasoning in medical and financial domains

work.name: Indian School of Business
work.summary: Full-time researcher working on AI for Social Good and computational social science projects with Prof. Sumeet Kumar
highlights: Publications at top-tier venues: NeurIPS, ACL, ASONAM, INFORMS Journal on Computing, INFORMS on Data Science, and AAAI
Awarded prestigious Kathuria Pre-Doctoral Scholarship from Shri Nihal Chand Kathuria Education Trust
Developed YouTube Dislikes dataset and conducted studies on gender biases and stereotyping in children's videos
Collaborated on automatic speech recognition failure detection and correction dataset published at AAAI

awards.title: Nobel Prize in Physics
awards.summary: The Nobel Prizes are five separate prizes that, according to Alfred Nobel's will of 1895, are awarded to 'those who, during the preceding year, have conferred the greatest benefit to humankind.'

publications.name: Zur Elektrody/namik bewegter Körper
publications.summary: It concerned an interpretation of the Michelson–Morley experiment and the properties of light and time. Special relativity incorporates the principle that the speed of light is the same for all inertial observers regardless of the state of motion of the source.

publications.name: Über einen die Erzeugung und Verwandlung des Lichtes betreffenden heuristischen Gesichtspunkt
publications.summary: In the second paper, he applied the quantum theory to light to explain the photoelectric effect. In particular, he used the idea of light quanta (photons) to explain experimental results, but stressed the importance of the experimental results. The importance of his work on the photoelectric effect earned him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921.

publications.name: Die Grundlage der allgemeinen Relativitätstheorie
publications.summary: The publication of the theory of general relativity made him internationally famous. He was professor of physics at the universities of Zurich (1909–1911) and Prague (1911–1912), before he returned to ETH Zurich (1912–1914).
